description: `cli job pause JOB_ID` gets the `cli job stop` explanation: deleting a job stops its future runs; there is no pause. (JSON envelope)

problem.action: Use `cli job delete`: `prose --output json cli job delete 3c1a9e57-0b4d-4f2a-9e61-5d7b2c8a4f10`.

details.reason: unknown command `cli job pause`; did you mean `cli job delete JOB_ID`? deleting a job stops its future runs; there is no pause; a run in progress is cancelled with `cli run cancel RUN_ID --yes`
